title: 真实partial与shallow克隆对照：保留历史但暂缺blob，不等于截断提交历史
source: 独立编审：Git对象、协作与交付审查
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 说明对象或操作边界及验证证据

conversion.original_title: partial clone与shallow clone分别减少什么？

body:
## 操作任务
实现describe_clone(repo)，只读返回shallow（真实rev-parse浅仓标志）、promisor（remote.origin.promisor为true）、history（本地HEAD可遍历提交数）、missing_objects（rev-list --objects --all --no-object-names --missing=print中?对象个数）。不得为了判对象类型调用会惰性取回缺失内容的cat-file/show，不fetch/unshallow、不改配置。屏蔽全局/系统配置及继承GIT_*重定向。实际对照blob:none/no-checkout的4提交promisor、depth1的完整当前内容、普通完整克隆；检查器在只读核验结束后才明确从私有origin取一个blob，重新检查数量与历史。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Git file://私有origin与克隆，网络关闭、只在自建临时目录传输对象；没有外部托管服务、认证/默认身份变更或OpsForge真实仓库操作。该blob:none模型的缺失对象是blob，不推断所有filter都只省blob；浅仓本地history不代表服务器完整历史。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现describe_clone(repo)，只读返回shallow（真实rev-parse浅仓标志）、promisor（remote.origin.promisor为true）、history（本地HEAD可遍历提交数）、missing_objects（rev-list --objects --all --no-object-names --missing=print中?对象个数）。不得为了判对象类型调用会惰性取回缺失内容的cat-file/show，不fetch/unshallow、不改配置。屏蔽全局/系统配置及继承GIT_*重定向。实际对照blob:none/no-checkout的4提交promisor、depth1的完整当前内容、普通完整克隆；检查器在只读核验结束后才明确从私有origin取一个blob，重新检查数量与历史。
exercise.validation_scope: 真实Git file://私有origin与克隆，网络关闭、只在自建临时目录传输对象；没有外部托管服务、认证/默认身份变更或OpsForge真实仓库操作。该blob:none模型的缺失对象是blob，不推断所有filter都只省blob；浅仓本地history不代表服务器完整历史。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import sys,os,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,hashlib,secrets
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()));import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('GIT_')};env.update(GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM='1',GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=os.devnull,GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0',GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0',GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='Fixture',GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid',GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='Fixture',GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='fixture@example.invalid')
def git(repo,*args):
 p=subprocess.run(['git','-c','maintenance.auto=false','-c','commit.gpgsign=false','-c','core.hooksPath='+os.devnull,'-c','protocol.file.allow=always','-C',str(repo),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=7);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr;return p.stdout.strip()
def snapshot(repo):
 return {p.relative_to(repo).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (repo/'.git').rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-clone-shape-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);origin=root/'owned-origin';origin.mkdir();git(origin,'init','--object-format=sha1','-b','main')
 for i in range(4):
  (origin/('f'+str(i)+'.txt')).write_text(str(i)+'-'+secrets.token_hex(32)+'x'*4096);git(origin,'add','.');git(origin,'commit','-m','fixture '+str(i))
 git(origin,'config','uploadpack.allowFilter','true');git(origin,'config','uploadpack.allowAnySHA1InWant','true')
 partial=root/'partial';shallow=root/'shallow';full=root/'full'
 git(root,'clone','--filter=blob:none','--no-checkout','--no-local',origin.as_uri(),str(partial))
 git(root,'clone','--depth=1','--no-local',origin.as_uri(),str(shallow));git(root,'clone','--no-local',origin.as_uri(),str(full))
 def missing(repo):return sum(line.startswith('?') for line in git(repo,'rev-list','--objects','--all','--no-object-names','--missing=print').splitlines())
 initial_missing=missing(partial);assert initial_missing==4,'owned server did not honor blob:none filter'
 assert git(partial,'rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository')=='false' and git(shallow,'rev-parse','--is-shallow-repository')=='true'
 print('NATIVE_GIT_PROMISOR_BLOB_NONE_FOUR_COMMITS_VERSUS_SHALLOW_ONE_COMMIT',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:describe_clone_without_lazy_fetch',flush=True)
 def inspect(repo,expected):
  before=snapshot(repo)
  try:actual=task.describe_clone(repo)
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student clone evidence inspection failed') from error
  assert actual==expected,actual
  assert snapshot(repo)==before,'inspection fetched objects or altered repository metadata'
 inspect(partial,dict(shallow=False,promisor=True,history=4,missing_objects=4))
 inspect(shallow,dict(shallow=True,promisor=False,history=1,missing_objects=0))
 inspect(full,dict(shallow=False,promisor=False,history=4,missing_objects=0))
 # Explicit fixture-only content access after the read-only inspection proves lazy retrieval.
 content=git(partial,'show','HEAD:f3.txt');assert content==(origin/'f3.txt').read_text()
 remaining=missing(partial);assert remaining<initial_missing
 inspect(partial,dict(shallow=False,promisor=True,history=4,missing_objects=remaining))
 assert git(full,'rev-parse','HEAD')==git(origin,'rev-parse','HEAD')==git(partial,'rev-parse','HEAD')
 print('NATIVE_GIT_INSPECTION_PRESERVES_PROMISED_ABSENCE_EXPLICIT_LOCAL_CONTENT_READ_FETCHES_LATER',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
